# Always Honest RV Rentals

> San Diego RV rentals with clear, transparent pricing. Owner: Ekaterina Zvezdova. Phone/text: 619-992-0289. Email: honestrvrentals@gmail.com. Pickup and return: Sycuan Casino Resort, 5469 Casino Way, El Cajon, CA 92019.

Every trip is quoted as one TOTAL: nightly rate + $199 trip preparation + $99 Interior Essentials (once per trip), plus 10% system processing and 8.75% taxes. Paying direct with Zelle waives the 10% processing. Holiday and special event dates are priced higher.

A king suite up front and a rear guest room with its own bath and outside door, plus a loft above it. Ideal when two couples or several generations travel together.

Five slideouts, a fireplace and theater seating create a living room that feels like a house.

A full-size diesel coach that lives like a small apartment: king bedroom, a bath and a half, washer and dryer, and a residential fridge with an ice maker. Built for groups who want real space and a quiet, smooth ride on long highway days.

Huge 100 gal fresh tank and factory solar for longer stays away from hookups.

Park it, plug in and you are set up. A smart pick for first-time RVers who want room for a family without the size of a big coach.

## FAQ
### How much does it cost to rent an RV in San Diego?
Nightly rates at Always Honest RV Rentals run $125 to $255 per night: travel trailers $125 to $165, fifth wheels and toy haulers $249 to $255, Class C motorhomes $185 to $225. Every trip also includes a $199 trip preparation charge and $99 Interior Essentials once per trip, plus 10% system processing and 8.75% taxes. The website shows the full TOTAL for 1 to 7 nights so there are no surprise fees. Holiday and special event dates are priced higher.

### What is included in the BASE STANDARD package?
The nightly rental rate, a smart TV upgrade with streaming (Wi-Fi or hotspot required), essential supplies, a tutorial orientation walkthrough, trip start and trip end inspections, commercial coverage insurance or an insurance waiver for deliveries, an interior damage protection liability waiver for common occurrences, system processing and taxes. Every RV is professionally cleaned inside and washed outside between rentals, and starts each trip with full propane and full fuel.

### What essential supplies come with every rental?
Outdoor: power cable, fresh water hose and septic hose (blocks and chocks on request). Indoor: septic-safe toilet paper, hand soap, dish soap, sponge, paper towel roll, surface wipes, a pot and a pan, 4 camping sets of plates, bowls, cups and silverware, a small trash can with garbage bag, and a broom and mop. Extra camping sets are free on request the day of pickup.

### Where do I pick up and return the RV?
Pickup and return are at Sycuan Casino Resort, 5469 Casino Way, El Cajon, CA 92019. Pickup is at 2:00 PM and return is by 12:00 PM. Early pickup and late return can be requested as add-ons.

### Do you deliver RVs and trailers?
Yes. Trailers can be delivered, set up and picked up at your campsite in the San Diego area for $399. Ask about other locations.

### What is the cancellation policy?
Cancel the same day you book for a free full refund. Cancel 30 or more days before your trip and your payment becomes a future trip credit, less the 10% system processing. Within 30 days of your trip, bookings are non-refundable. Extenuating circumstances and emergencies are reviewed case by case.

### Is there a discount for paying directly?
Yes. Pay direct with Zelle to honestrvrentals@gmail.com (Always Honest RV Rentals) and the 10% system processing is waived. Put your trip dates or quote number in the Zelle memo.

### How many miles and generator hours are included?
Motorhomes include 150 miles per night ($0.35 per mile after) and 6 generator hours per night ($5 per hour after). Travel trailers and fifth wheels have unlimited mileage.

### Are dogs allowed?
Dogs are welcome with approval for a $100 fee per dog. Service animals are free.

### Can I tow a trailer myself?
Yes, if your vehicle is rated to tow the trailer and has a brake controller and the right hitch. Each listing shows the towing requirement. Not sure? Ask before you book, or add delivery and setup.
